stemMd: A manufacturer claims that a more durable coating will reduce lifetime maintenance expenditure despite its higher purchase price. Which information would most help assess the claim?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The number of colours in the old product catalogue.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The expected timing and cost of maintenance under each coating over the relevant service life.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The marketing name chosen for the new coating.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Whether the new coating was announced on a Monday.

explanationMd: The claim compares an upfront premium with future maintenance savings. Their timing, size, and relevant horizon are needed to decide whether the savings offset the premium.

distractorRationale.d: A name does not quantify maintenance savings.
distractorRationale.c: Uniforms are unrelated to coating costs.
distractorRationale.a: Catalogue breadth does not establish lifetime expenditure.
distractorRationale.e: Announcement timing does not bear on the financial comparison.
